text:
deploy-bot: Starting deploy window: release/2026-03-20/rdw-inference-1.8 -> canary 5% us-west1 at 07:00 UTC. Backout plan attached.

mia: Copy. Can someone confirm model pin for canary? we should pin to rdlw-gpt-4f:1.8-canary, not HEAD.

jon: Confirmed. pinning to rdlw-gpt-4f:1.8-canary. Canary routes 5% traffic -> canary pool. Full rollout only after health=OK for 10m.

sasha: Quick note: autoscaler cooldown is 3m on dedicated pools. If latency spikes, we should disable autoscale before rollback to avoid noisy nodes.

mia: Adding the backout checklist here so it's easy to run if needed:
```
# BACKOUT CHECKLIST (short)
1) Route canary -> stable: `redwood routing set-weight --route inference --to stable --percent 100`
2) Pin customers on dedicated to prev model: `redwood routing pin --model rdlw-gpt-4f:1.7-stable --scope dedicated`
3) Scale down canary pool: `redwood pool scale --name canary-usw1 --replicas 0`
4) Revert infra changes (if any) and clear caches: follow runbook https://intra.redwood/ops/backout-runbook
```

opsbot: Note: Incident channel notify step will run automatically if rollback takes >5m. Use `ops escalate` to page SMEs.

jon: If we need an emergency abort (pre-10m) do not wait for analytics; run the 0->100 route switch and then pin. That will cut impact fastest.

mia: Confirming release notes include the fallback routing change and quantization profile update. I'll attach CHANGES.md to the release.

cheng: Heads up — there is a DB migration for evals in the A/B reporter that is backward compatible, but take a snapshot before full rollout. (snapshot command in runbook).

sasha: Can we set a manual canary kill-switch on the console? I'll add a one-click runbook shortcut.

mia: Doing a final preflight checklist now: prometheus alerts set? synthetic test running? tracing enabled?

jon: All set except one synthetic failing intermittently (error 503 on kv-cache hit). If it doesn't clear in 4m -> roll back.

mia: Roger. Initiating canary at 07:00 UTC. If anyone sees >2% error delta or latency p50 +30% for 3 consecutive 1m buckets, start backout checklist above and ping #incidents. :rotating_light:

deploy-bot: Canary started at 07:00:03 UTC. Deploy ID: 2026-03-20-07-1799001234. Monitoring windows open.
